# Objective

Implement the manifest-defined `CeDG Construction` workspace on
`feature/g9u1-construction-workspace`.

**PROPOSED FUTURE PROMPT — UNEXECUTED AND NOT AUTHORIZED.**

# Mandatory entry gate

Require G9U0 and G9X1 author-approved PASS, normative workspace spec, Accepted
ADR 0012, resolved name/groups, clean branch, prompt hash and composed PASS.

# Hard dependencies

Author-approved G9U0 public actions and G9X1 export actions, plus the approved
manifest/workspace contract, are hard dependencies. G9B and G9C are not; U1
must not publish spatial-family authority on their behalf.

# Recommended execution predecessor

Execute after U0 and X1 in the recommended integrated schedule, with G9O1
available for reproducible guide/profile context. This ordering does not make
U1 a semantic prerequisite of G9B.

# Global/release gate

U1 is the application-track input to global G9 closeout. It remains a
presentation/action-exposure gate and cannot certify spatial mathematics.

# Authority and evidence hierarchy

Read current profile/schema/AppGeoCeDG/LayoutD/Perspective/menu/controller code,
reference GGB audit and approved workspace/public-action contracts.

# Scope

Extend application-profile schema and compiler for named workspaces, views,
docking, bottom input, toolbar help, task/action groups, maturity/feature gates,
icons/localization/help, saved-layout policy and Construction workspace
switching. Expose the approved point-on-Locus, Locus V2 metric/intersection/token
and DXF actions without reimplementing their semantics.

# Explicitly forbidden scope

No geometric semantics, new commands/algorithms, hard-coded duplicate toolbar,
model-specific macro promotion, Classic mutation, Dihedral Procedures
implementation, or reinterpretation of loaded objects.

# Editable boundaries

Profile/schema/features/resources, GeoCeDG desktop workspace compiler/controller,
frontend tests, docs/evidence/verifier and minimum registered upstream seams.

# Productive versus test-private permissions

Approved workspace/profile runtime is productive. Reference GGBs/macros remain
immutable evidence and test fixtures, never default product tools.

# Architectural placement

Workspace layout and action exposure belong to the application/frontend layer;
the manifest is the single declarative source and cannot define geometric truth.

# Required design/specification

Implement the approved task groups, stable action IDs, selection contracts,
feature maturity, contextual help, localization, icon ownership and document
saved-layout precedence.

# Geometric invariants and degeneracies

Switching workspace changes presentation/actions only. It cannot recompute,
replace, hide semantically, or reinterpret geometry.

# Compatibility and serialization

Legacy saved perspectives remain explicit document state; profile defaults apply
only when appropriate. GeoCeDG Classic stays a separate diagnostic process/path
but changes presentation only: supported V2/rich/spatial objects remain native,
retain IDs/tokens/bindings, and use the same kernel semantics. External upstream
open for unknown GeoCeDG persisted types is unsupported and never triggers a
silent lossy downgrade.

# Required tests and commands

Test schema failures, generated toolbar/layout, every action mapping/gate, saved
GGB precedence, preferences, switch idempotence, help/localization/icon ownership,
point-on-Locus selection/provider constraints, Locus/DXF action dispatch,
GeoCeDG Classic isolation/launch/native-preservation routing and external-open
messaging. Run focused G9U1 and full composed verification.

# Required artifacts

Schema/profile/source/resources/tests, screenshots as generated evidence only,
mapping/traceability, focused verifier and report.

# Stop conditions

Stop if layout needs a second hard-coded authority, a reference macro would be
promoted as stable, switching alters geometry, or resource rights are unclear.
